Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the end date as 24 February 1942 by conflating a separate engagement (“Palembang II”) with the Battle of Palembang and “using the latest date” without verification. This contradicted the visible search results indicating the battle occurred 13–15 February 1942 (ending 15 February) and was not confirmed by opening sources, leading to an unsupported final answer.
